description: Altri temi - ELF - Linee elettriche - Cartografie is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by arcgis.com. The cartography contains the geometries of the objects belonging to the high-voltage "ELF - Cadastre of Electrical Lines". With regard to these objects, the catographic layers of the geometries with which some alphanumeric information is also associated are available. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Other themes - ELF - Power lines - Cartography" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Energy resources, n.d.. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WMS, WFS. The listing shows 2020-04-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
